problems.title: The supported encoder string bypasses GNN preprocessing
problems.source_location: Appendix A.1 and A.4, PDF pp.14–15; released main.py, lines 57, 91–139 and 149–164
claim: `main.py` accepts `gatedgcn` in construction and the README, but the reverse-edge/configuration predicate accepts only `gnn` or `gin`.
analysis: Therefore `gatedgcn` takes the alternative configuration before constructing GatedGCN. A directed three-node chain retains two edges rather than the required four after reverse augmentation. For NB-301, that branch uses two layers rather than the stated three. No preceding alias conversion repairs this path; GIN and FlowerFormer are consistent-route controls.
result: The documented release command differs from the appendix protocol. Which program produced each original score is unresolved.
assumptions: Only the cited paper version and explicitly described mathematical or implementation conditions are assessed.
repair: Use `gatedgcn` consistently in preprocessing, default selection and construction, then specify the historical experiment configuration.
problems.impact_rationale: This is a public reproduction-path error with no established central result damage.
problems.existing_correction_status: An explicit local correction is described; author adoption and a corresponding published erratum are not established.

problems.title: Non-rejection does not establish distributional equality
problems.source_location: Appendix B.9.1 and Figure 11, PDF p.20
claim: Appendix B.9.1 and Figure 11 infer the same performance distribution from non-rejecting paired signed-rank tests on nine trials per initialization.
analysis: Nine nonzero differences with absolute ranks one through nine and positive rank sum \(25\) give exact two-sided probability \(0.8203125\). That non-rejecting rank/sign pattern has positive probability under a continuous symmetric difference law centered at a nonzero shift. Thus non-rejection cannot establish equality, even under a valid test model. The raw trials and pairing are not reconstructed.
result: The tests did not detect differences in that sample. No actual difference between the paper’s initialization populations is asserted.
assumptions: Only the cited paper version and explicitly described mathematical or implementation conditions are assessed.
repair: State non-detection at the nominal \(0.05\) level. A practical-equivalence claim requires a prespecified tolerance, effect estimates and an appropriate uncertainty analysis.
problems.impact_rationale: This is overinterpretation of a small auxiliary statistical comparison, not a refutation of the central mean improvements.
problems.existing_correction_status: An explicit local correction is described; author adoption and a corresponding published erratum are not established.
